endorsements.quote: Through use of strategies such as co-designing technologies with patient feedback, offering structured digital literacy training and onboarding, and integrating digital programs into established clinic and safety-net settings, future implementations may improve uptake across diverse patient populations.
Ultimately, for AI to be valuable in real-world clinical settings, it must be optimized to support patients and clinicians without increasing clinical or administrative workload.

unlisted_practices: Position AI tools, including LLM chatbots, as complements rather than substitutes for human connection in patient care.
Use hybrid trial designs that evaluate both clinical efficacy and implementation outcomes of digital health tools in routine clinical settings.
